description: Liquid AI's text-only mixture-of-experts model for reasoning and tool-using agents, with 24B total and 2.45B active parameters. It always thinks before answering and supports structured output. Pair it with retrieval for knowledge-heavy tasks. Open weights use the LFM Open License v1.0, with a $10M annual-revenue commercial threshold; hosted API use is subject to separate service terms that permit retention and use of prompts and responses for model training.
name: LFM2.5 24B A2B
